title: Jerry Lynn pushes RVD to his limits
summary: Jerry Lynn repeatedly threatens the confidence of ECW’s Television champion. Their rivalry becomes a showcase for athletic counters, disputed limits and the challenger’s insistence on earning a decisive victory.

chapters.title: Lynn asks for five more minutes
chapters.result: Van Dam defeats Lynn after the match is extended.
chapters.context: Lynn rejects a referee’s decision in his favor at the time limit and insists on continuing.

chapters.title: No time limit, another RVD victory
chapters.result: Van Dam defeats Lynn to retain the Television title.
chapters.context: Removing the time limit gives their rematch a decisive finish while preserving Lynn as a leading challenger.

chapters.title: Lynn wins after Anton’s betrayal
chapters.result: Lynn defeats the returning Van Dam after Scotty Anton interferes.
chapters.context: Lynn gets the result, but outside interference complicates the long-awaited victory and starts RVD’s next feud.
